chapter: Becoming a player; Rene, Bunk and Armstrong
title: Punch Miller
summary: Punch Miller's runs and arpeggios, and playing with him in Chicago in the 1920s and 30s.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well Punch Miller, he made a lot of stuff. Yeah, he made a lot of his runs and arpeggios and things like that. And you see poor Punch here. We used to play concerts quite often in Chicago. And Punch used to, you know, too much, too much. Played with him in the 20's?
Huh? Did you play with him in the 20's? Yeah.
Yeah, in the early 30's too. Was he like that then too?
Yeah, yeah, yeah. He had the power, he was good in those days.
Yeah, guy carried it too. All the time, yeah.
